text: Use image asset(id) for a real raster, svg(icon:name) for a supported library icon, and vector path("…") for a native path. An image declaration needs a real asset ID. Logo or product images must remain authentic independent assets.

Fit, focal point and alt text belong to AssetPlacement, set by asset(action="place"); they are not DSL image-leaf properties … Use contain for a full logo; choose product/image fit by inspecting the crop. A slot's image_policy is the separate future-binding contract described above.
note: "Described above" refers to grammar.md context it is spliced into.

text: For text over imagery, establish legible contrast in the actual composite. A tonal region, changed placement or suitable native plate/scrim can provide it; no scrim or fixed frame pattern is compulsory. Declaration order controls stacking.
